name: COHATCH

items.address: THIS IS AN ALTERATION OF AN EXISTING RESIDENTIAL HOME INTO A ONE-STORY COMMERCIAL COWORKING SPACE. THE EXISTING 845 SF MAIN HISTORIC HOME WILL BE RENOVATED AND THE EXISTING REAR ADDITION AND PORCH WILL BE REBUILT IN PLACE. THIS IS A CHANGE OF OCCUPANCY FROM RESIDENTIAL TO B-BUSINESS USE. THE PROJECT WILL INCLUDE ALTERATIONS & UPDATES TO THE. EXTERIOR, INTERIOR, PLUMBING, MECHANICAL, ELECTRICAL, AND STRUCTURAL. THIS BUILDING IS A PART OF DUBLIN, OH ARB CASE #24-133FDP.
